title: Grossly Overpriced
text: Subscribed & received 1st box for Small Breeds. The description states you receive a ‘Box Full’ of treats suitable for small dogs. The box contained 7 treats. 7 treats is hardly a ‘Box Full’! I have no problem paying for quality treats but IMO this box is grossly overpriced at $25. (Thankfully the first box is half price!) Also, the treats were much too large & hard for my 2 small breed dogs. (7 lb Chihuahua & 12 lb Chiweenie) The quality of the treats seemed fine but due to the amount & size of treats, I cancelled my subscription.
label: neutral
